name: LG UltraGear
notes: LG ignores the standard input-select. Uses VCP 0xF4 sent from source address 0x50. Tested on the 45GR75DC-B.

name: MCCS standard
notes: Standard DDC/CI input select (VCP 0x60 from 0x51). Values vary by vendor; USB-C has no standard value (Dell uses 0x1B). Use Try to find yours.
